user_reviews.Name: Michelle
user_reviews.Description:
Just Leaks Inc. is the best roofing service around. Not only is their work exceptional, but their business ethics, customer service, and practices set them apart from other trade businesses in the valley. They do what they promise, are transparent about pricing and timeframes, and go above and beyond to assist people in both non-critical and difficult situations.

Yesterday, during heavy rain, the roof in my primary bedroom began leaking onto my bed and the surrounding floor. Despite having a full schedule, Miguel from Just Leaks Inc. sent his technician team Sergio and Samuel to my home. They were able to address the emergency the same day. Miguel followed up to ensure everything was okay, demonstrating genuine care and concern.

This is not the first time I've worked with this business. The last time was non-critical. I was given a detailed evaluation of the condition of my roof, pictures of the areas needing to be addressed and a professional quote for the job. Compared to other roofing services they were more complete in the information they provided and more reasonably priced. Once they completed the work they sent me after photos for my records and walked me through what they did.

It’s rare to find businesses that go the extra mile like this—I highly recommend Just Leaks Inc. for their outstanding service and commitment to their customers.

user_reviews.Name: Jonathan Fishpaw
user_reviews.Description:
I had a great experience with Fluid Dynamics and would certainty recommend them to others. My commercial water heater broke at my On-Premise-Laundry facility and I reached out to them because I knew their facility was close by and had seen their van around. I heat water constantly and it is an important part of cleaning laundry.

Ronald came out in a couple of hours to inspect my water heater and give me options repairing or replacing it and what might have led me to this point. I appreciated that he wasn't trying to sway me in either direction and was sharing his knowledge about how to evaluate the decision.  I decided to replace it and add a thermal expansion tank. Also got a utility sink quoted and setup for install.

We schedule for the replacement when I could stop operations for a few hours for Vince and Lalo to complete the install. They arrived a few minutes early to get the old water heater draining so when the new one was delivered it could wheel from the truck right into place. Vince worked through the project diligently, was clean in his workspace and left my shop looking good. Took all the trash away and ensured we I was back to washing as fast as possible.

This vendor was excellent to work with. From the initial conversation through delivery, they were organized, responsive, and transparent. I thought the value for the service was good. They handled everything professionally and followed through on every commitment.

user_reviews.Name: Kristina Drake
user_reviews.Description: After buying my home in San Jose, I thought the roof would last a good while since it looked solid from the street. But when I called Rooflow Roof Repair & Installation to remove some moss, Troy took a close look and showed me photos of the roof’s surface. I learned the sun had worn down the granules on the back side, leaving the felt exposed to the elements. Troy was really helpful in picking out new roofing materials and gave me a clear estimate. He also took time to help me choose a color that would boost my home’s curb appeal in our sunny California weather. Although we had to wait a bit due to some rainy spells, the delay was worth it. Troy kept checking in on my roof, and as soon as there were a few sunny days, the crew arrived right on time. The team worked efficiently, removing the old roof and putting in the new one. My house has a unique back soffit that needed extra attention, which added a bit more time, but they handled it with care. Throughout the process, the crew was careful not to damage my flowers and left everything neat and clean. Getting a new roof is a big investment, and it’s important to work with experienced professionals. I’m very happy with my new roof—it looks fantastic and really makes my house stand out!

user_reviews.Name: Misha S
user_reviews.Description:
I had a great experience with Freddy and his team at Freedom Underground at my Menlo Park residence.

It was a hairy situation where I needed to install a new sewer line down a shared driveway and into the public street. Various permits and inspections from the city as well as the sanitary district were needed, I had some concerned neighbors to deal with, and we had to do it in a way that protects a large heritage tree right near the work.

Freddy was extremely patient and creative during the scoping process. He understood the requirements and concerns of all parties involved and offered different solutions based on what the needs were. He and his office manager Fiona did a good job of managing all the admin stuff as well. I never felt like the team didn't know what they were doing or didn't have a plan.

Once the job started, Miguel did an excellent job managing the work and the team. His communication was great and he quickly corrected course based on any concerns or requirements raised. Miguel was a good foreman.

I felt in good hands the whole time and I thought the team was very diligent in cleaning up each day, keeping me updated on progress, etc. I'd definitely work with them again.

user_reviews.Name: Mahmud Ischanov
user_reviews.Description:
My 60 year old galvanized main water line pipe decided to spring a leak one cold Saturday evening... I had to scramble to turn the water off at the meter. As soon as I did, I started calling around plumbers that could come out quick to help me fix the pipe, as i had no water in the house of 5 people. No showers, washing hands or using toilets.
4 guys came out, Freddy from Freedom was 2nd lowest offer. What sold me on his quote was that he was going to use a trenchless tunneling system called the HammerHead (minimize trenching and destruction of 50 feet of my yard) and the fact that he suggested that he install a pressure regulator without being asked (unlike the other plumbers). The pressure regulator is important because after replacing a 60 year old corroded galvanized steel pipe with brand new copper line, the water pressure in the house could go up dramatically, causing damage to appliances and pipes in the house. Freddy even agreed to install a Flo by Moen leak detection system at no additional charge.
I am glad I decided to go with Freddy, his guys showed up on time the next morning, as agreed. His crew of guys (Christian and 4 others) worked non-stop, tirelessly and professionally. I could definitely tell the guys take pride in their work, they all did a fantastic job.
I would recommend Freddy and Freedom Underground, they are awesome!

user_reviews.Name: Ashish Kalani
user_reviews.Description:
Freedom Underground Plumbing replaced our main sewer and water lines. The main sewer line replacement was done entirely trench-less, whereas the water line replacement was a combination of trench-less and open trench. The entire work was done in a timely manner and with great quality; we passed inspections without any issues. The water line replacement was a bit complex with multiple turns. The crew used smooth turns on the line where possible and we have had no drop in water pressure in the house or in the irrigation lines. The crew did its best to leave the landscape looking as much like before as possible. They even put back the grass cover that had to be removed for digging a wide hole.

Freddy, the owner, gave me a quote that was competitive with the others I received. However I chose to go with Freedom Underground because Freddy genuinely seemed interested in providing the best solution for our needs. The foremen, Alex and Christian were both very responsive to my questions and kept me up-to-date with what was being done. I requested a change-order for replacing part of the sewer line under the house, and the quote provided was reasonable.

Overall, I am very happy with the experience and whole-heartedly recommend Freedom Underground for underground replacement work.

user_reviews.Name: Gregory Dibb
user_reviews.Description:
I needed my septic tank completely pumped out so I could start getting rid of it.  I called a couple of different places and Able had the best price, but they charge extra if it takes them longer than half an hour.  Well they came and did a fabulous job.  Very helpful, very thorough--helped dig around the tank, etc.  The only problem is it took them 1.5 hours, which ended up costing me quite a bit more than the original quote.  For me 5 star service would mean that before working that extra time and going that extra mile they ask me.  I might have said yes because they did do a good job, but I might have been okay after just 30 mins.

So my advice to company is: ask the customer if they prefer the extra work/cleaning or if they prefer to rush and stay under 30 mins.  my advice to customer: be clear you expect the job to be done in 30 mins, so they aren't extra helpful and then charge you for it.

user_reviews.Name: John Al-Samarrie
user_reviews.Description:
OK, this is overdue.  Last month I noticed water on the garage cement floor and thought it was just moisture.  After careful review I noticed that the water heater was leaking.  I called four different plumbers to get estimates with Drain Doctor being the first one I called.  A little history of my previous water heater is in order.  in 2019 I was overseas, and the heater broke and leaked all over the garage damaging some important personal items.  My girlfriend at the time called a plumber who installed a new heater and what a mess it was.  That plumber used galvanized steel for the inlet and outlet of the heater lines.  Routed the pressure relief pipe into the water heater pan rather than outside of the pan and installed my recirculating pump facing the side wall where I could not gain access.  Additionally, the gas line reservoir was installed by the water heater rather than near the gas line valve coming out of the wall.  There were no 2x4 boards in the back of the heater for earth quake bracing and the water lines were not earth grounded, all of which are city compliance requirement.  To say the least it was a cluster F.  When Bobby from Drain doctor showed up, he immediately pointed out the nonconformance of the water heater and gave me a bottom-line price from his standard pricing book which no other plumbers could beat.  Some quotes were almost double and after negotiating with those plumbers they got close to Bobby's price which didn't sit well with me.  So, I decided to go with Bobby and that proved to be fortuitist based on his efficient and compliant work.  Bobby is a plethora of plumbing information or more like a Wikipedia of plumbing.  He does have a laid back and straight forward attitude but don't let that fool you.  He's the top gun in his industry.  Anyway, I've read some of the negative reviews and in each case, there has been a unique set circumstance that all of us experienced in our daily life but over 99%+ of Drain Doctor reviews are very positive.  I can't tell you how happy we are with his work and in fact our outside main water line inlet valve was broken, unbeknown to us and we had him come back the next day to fix that as well.  I didn't bother getting other quotes because I knew Bobby would give us a competitive price but more importantly do the job right.
Anyway, you can't go wrong with Drain Doctor and ask for Bobby.  Bobby is your man.
Lastley, I don’t usually write reviews, but I was so impressed with the work I was compelled to write about our experience.
Thank you,
John A.

user_reviews.Name: Matt Baxter
user_reviews.Description: We had some ceiling damage in the kitchen and called Eastman for an inspection. He also identified potential issues, with a crack on the roof ridge, tape coming off some pipe jacks, and loose counter-flashing around the chimney. Some of these I would never have found myself due to them being virtually inaccessible to an amateur. The work was scheduled for up to a few weeks in the future due to the busy winter season, but they were out within a week or so. The repair folks sent photos of all work as soon as it was completed, and Ramon was very responsive with some follow up work to install some maintenance grates to prevent gutter back up. Prices were as quoted and seemed very fair. We would recommend Eastman Roofing quite highly for their quick and thorough work.

user_reviews.Name: Jacquelin Lloyde
user_reviews.Description:
I am 94 years old and live by myself, and it can be very difficult for me to manage home repairs. I do not use the internet very much, but Joseph kindly showed me how to use speech-to-text on my phone so I could leave this review myself. I truly wanted people to know how wonderful he was.

For weeks, there was a loud humming noise every time I used the water, and it was driving me crazy. At my age, you appreciate peace and quiet, and the sound was very upsetting.

From the moment he arrived, he treated me with patience, kindness, and respect. I am hard of hearing and move slowly because of arthritis, and he never once rushed me. He took his time to listen carefully and explain everything in a way I could understand.

He didn’t just fix the problem — he checked my whole plumbing system to make sure everything was safe. No plumber has ever done that for me before.

He even had to cut into some of the stucco to do the repair properly, and I was worried the price might go up. It never did. He kept his word exactly. That meant a lot to me.

In my long life, I have met many contractors. Joseph stands out as one of the most honest, hardworking, and compassionate young men I have ever encountered. His workmanship is beautiful, and his character is even better.

If you want someone who truly cares, who does the job right, and who treats you like family, call Allstar Plumbing and ask for Joseph.

Thank you, Joseph. You really are an Allstar.

user_reviews.Name: Johnny DeLuna
user_reviews.Description:
After three other HVAC companies failed to fix our comfort issues, we were frustrated and running out of options. Each one suggested replacing equipment but couldn’t clearly explain what was actually wrong. When Calvey Heating & Air came out, the difference was immediate.

The estimator took the time to fully evaluate our system instead of jumping straight to a sales pitch. He inspected the ductwork and quickly found the real problem, our system was operating outside manufacturer specifications due to poor return airflow design and duct inefficiencies. The other companies completely missed this.

He clearly explained why our system was short-cycling, why certain rooms were uncomfortable, and how airflow problems were affecting overall efficiency. For the first time, we felt confident someone truly understood the root cause.

The installation crew was just as impressive. They reworked sections of our duct system, improved return airflow, and sealed connections to reduce leakage and increase efficiency. They installed a properly matched variable-speed heat pump system and carefully calibrated it for correct performance.

They weighed in the refrigerant charge exactly to manufacturer specs and verified system performance using superheat and subcooling measurements. Each register was adjusted to help ensure consistent temperatures throughout the home.

Now our system runs quieter, maintains steady temperatures, and uses noticeably less energy. The comfort difference is night and day.

From the knowledgeable estimator to the professional installation crew, the entire team was skilled, thorough, and solution-focused. While three other companies couldn’t figure it out, Calvey Heating & Air delivered a solution that works perfectly.

Highly recommend them for anyone who wants the job done right.

user_reviews.Name: Arthur Gu
user_reviews.Description:
Update: in response to this review, Mike Calvey reached out to me and tried to make it right.

Calvey is a company in which industry best practices are sometimes not followed.

In 2021, Calvey installed a 4-ton, single stage Bryant suitcase unit on my property.

This unit has seen less than 20 hr, likely less than 10 hr of runtime in these 3 years. It has evidence of an electrical fire due to completely loose - not even snugged connections on the contactor which should have been torqued to 35 in-lbs.

In my case, this led to the failure of the contactor, which lit on fire and shorted out the 24v control coil, which killed my Nest thermostat before blowing the fuse in my furnace.

This would very likely have been prevented if Calvey had followed industry best practices, which are to use a clamp meter to measure LRA and FLA to ensure they match the LRA/FLA rating. Taking this measurement immediately after installation helps prevent this kind of failure.

Calvey also installed a Bryant Condensing furnace on my property a few years before installing the air conditioner. The condensate pump was not wired with the safety shut off, meaning when the pump (which has a 5-10 year expected service life) inevitably fails, it will likely cause a flood in my mechanical room. Calvey not only failed to install the necessary wiring for the safe operation of the condensing furnace, they also failed to correct this error when installing an air conditioner several years later.

Further, some Calvey techs informed me they use 5% silver phos-copper brazing filler. Industry best practices are to use 15% silver phos-copper brazing filler because it has better flow characteristics, and lower odds of cracking with vibration/thermal expansion. 5% brazing filler is also often associated with the practice of "crowning" a joint, wherein rather than flowing braze into the joint, a crown is applied around the joint with very minimal penetration. I have not experienced a failure due to this, it is still a poor practice.

Calvey did not follow industry best practices in the installation of my HVAC system. The electrical fire and subsequent damage to the entire 24v electrical system of my home, as well as the sub-optimal brazing alloy and improper condensate pump installation, I cannot in good conscience recommend this company for your next HVAC project.

I cannot recommend Gomez Sewer & Drain enough. A++++++ !!!

user_reviews.Description:
Highly recommend .... Blue Splash Pool Service & Repair completely remodeled my Pool in June of 2025.  The Company was very competitive with the other “reasonable” quotes that I received, but their edge was the great job they did on my next-door neighbor’s pool as well.  Miguel was excellent at listening to what I wanted, but he also made great recommendations in doing the right things.  For example, I wanted to keep my old tiles, but Miguel convinced me to replace them… which in the end was the right thing to do.
Miguel and his team were extremely professional; they arrive on site with brand new White Blue Splash pool trucks and they have all the heavy-duty equipment to do the job right and timely.  For example, they had up 4 people with jack hammers to chisel out my old plaster.  They had up to 6 people repairing my Gunite issues and adding a new step to my Jacuzzi.  My pool was in terrible shape, being unused for 4 years, it had a few feet of muck and debris and it was even stocked with the county’s misquote fish.   So, Blue Splash had to start with cleaning out 4 years of stinky palm fronds and draining my pool into the city sewer so as to not clog up my draining system.  But now my pool and Jacuzzi now look fantastic (see Photos Below) with the blue tile and the upgraded pebble/gem plaster.   Miguel and his team did a fabulous job fixing up my pool equipment too, with added a new Heater and a new multi-colored light (all controllable with my phone).  I love the way they completely reorganized the layout from the old hodge-podge layout of the incremental upgrades made over the last 30 years to a new two new 3-position water diverter valves.  The new system makes it so much easier now to switch over to Jacuzzi mode vs the old 2 position and twist water valves I had to turn before. The great thing was, they were able to complete the remodeling in a few weeks and I was enjoying my pool before the end of June.  I would highly recommend Blue Splash Pool Service & Repair and Miguel to any one for their responsiveness to the pool owner’s need for cost, schedule, and doing the right things.

user_reviews.Name: Tanya Wieber
user_reviews.Description:
OMG!  We have found our new auto mechanic!  Kenny at LTBM Auto Service Center in San Jose!  A friend recently recommended this place to me, and just in time!  Only a week later we started having problems with my 2008 Toyota Sienna. The oxygen sensor was going bad.

Kenny was very knowledgeable and a joy to work with. We were able to get an appointment quickly. He discovered some additional problems (after all, the van is 18 years old, but only 80,000 miles and has been a good van for us).

Kenny was so thorough about communicating what he was finding. He sent photos so we could see the problems and provided the cost of each thing that needed repair so we could choose what we wanted done. His thorough inspection showed it needed the oxygen sensor as well as one ignition coil, radiator hose, steering rack, alignment, and a new battery. We also had him polish one headlight since it was starting to discolor due to constant sun hitting it. Wow!  It came out so nice!  And his price for everything was SO reasonable!!  So grateful for that since money is tight for us, as it is for many people.

When we picked up the van, only one day later, we got to see how much detail work he had done!  The engine was all cleaned up!  (There had been a previous oil leak.) Looked so nice!  And it runs so nice now!  Good to feel safe.

I’d also like to say how impressed we were with his shop. So clean and orderly!  I’m so grateful my friend had recommended Kenny at LTBM!!  We now have a trusted and very knowledgeable mechanic!

user_reviews.Name: Francis Pang
user_reviews.Description:
​I had a very disappointing and dangerous experience with this shop. I brought my car in January to repair a dent on the rear door and a misaligned latch. Niko assured me he could fix it. However, after picking up the car, the door actually opened by itself while I was driving on the freeway, and the car’s sensors repeatedly triggered a "door open" alert.
​When I took the vehicle to another shop for a second opinion, they discovered that instead of a proper repair, a hole had been drilled into the door and it had been held together with cheap wires. This "fix" destroyed the electronic transmitter inside. Because of this unauthorized and improper work, I am now forced to replace the entire door assembly rather than just the door shell.
​What was supposed to be a repair ended up worsening the damage and creating a major safety hazard. I cannot recommend this shop based on the quality and safety of the work performed.

user_reviews.Name: Skye Pejsa
user_reviews.Description:
I cannot recommend Niko highly enough! My car suddenly broke down after an "engine overheating" warning in San Jose due to an error that another car shop had made. I was in San Jose for a wedding and 3 hours away from home with my sister's graduation in a couple of days, so this was obviously terrible timing.
Niko was kind enough to take the car after hours, quickly diagnosed the hose and fan problem, was upfront about costs, gave me incredibly good prices on labor and parts, and wrote me a detailed report so that I could try to get refunded by the other car shop (I was, miraculously!). On top of being very knowledgeable and honest, Niko was also extremely kind and empathetic to my situation. Because the part for my BMW could not be sourced in time for my sister's graduation, he lent me his own car completely free of charge so that I could make it to her graduation and take my mom around during her brief week in California. I know it sounds crazy, but he really was my hero that whole week! I could not have done it without his generosity and expertise, and were my car ever in another bind, I would try to make it out to San Jose just to ensure it was in good hands. Thank you many times over, Niko! You're seriously the best!

user_reviews.Name: Laith Alquran
user_reviews.Description:
I had an incredible experience here! I called them because my 2019 BMW 330i was vibrating violently whenever it was in reverse or at low RPMs, and I suspected it might be the engine mounts. They told me to bring it in so they could confirm what was really going on. I dropped it off in the morning and they said they’d have an estimate by 3 p.m., but they actually called me back at noon (even though they were super busy) with a very fair price.

They originally said the repair might take until the next day, but they finished it the same day in just a few hours. The work they did was outstanding — the vibrations are completely gone, and now my car runs perfectly smooth. Everything was done quickly, fairly priced, and the service was excellent. The technicians clearly knew exactly what they were doing. They’re very experienced, knowledgeable, and you can tell they take pride in their work.

What stood out most was how honest they were. I even asked them to check the transmission mount, and instead of charging me to replace it, they told me it was still in good condition. That kind of honesty is rare.

Overall, I felt taken care of the whole way through. This shop is the real deal — honest, skilled, and professional. If I could give more than 5 stars, I would! I’ll definitely be coming back here and recommend them to anyone looking for an outstanding mechanic.

Caveat emptor… buyer beware!

Ryan,
We take feedback seriously, but your review does not accurately reflect the situation.
Your project was impacted by an internal staffing change that occurred unexpectedly. Rather than proceeding with incomplete coordination—which would have put your project at risk—we made the decision to pause and reassess internally. That is a responsible contractor move, not a lack of professionalism.
Communication could have been handled better on our end, and for that we take accountability. However, the characterization that we were “unaware” of the project or dismissive is not accurate. The project was fully documented; the delay was a matter of internal transition, not negligence.
Regarding pricing and timeline, we are very direct with clients when it comes to scope, cost, and execution. We do not negotiate against incomplete or uncertain conditions, and we do not commit to timelines we cannot confidently meet. That approach protects both parties, even if it may come across as firm.
We understand the frustration caused by the delay, but we will not compromise our standards or misrepresent commitments just to keep a project moving prematurely.
We wish you the best with your project moving forward.

user_reviews.Description:
We put off replacing our decades old roof for years fearing the project would be horrific. If we had known of Q7 Roofing & Waterproofing Inc. sooner, we would not have waited so long.

Our roof project finished up a few days ago in a timely manner and to a level beyond our expectations. If you are reading this and hesitant like we were, don’t put it off, consider getting on Q7’s schedule. We had several requests unique to our home and Q7 delivered on those. We are detail-oriented people and handy ourselves, so we seek high quality workmanship.

Q7 Roofing & Waterproofing Inc:
o	good listeners, good communicators

o	very hard workers

o	cleaned up property and supplies at the end of each day
o	had a commendable comradery – i.e. no yelling at each other nor drama

o	impressed by individual styles, skill sets, and contributions
o	one or more present each day resulting in good
communication and oversight
o	all city inspections approved at first pass

o	ensured attic was cleaned up of debris properly

Q7 Owners: Geo and Cesar. Wow.
o	incredibly impressed by their business acumen and genuine customer service.
o	present on our project at times - available to us, if needed.

We cannot truly know the entire quality job until the rains arrive, but we feel confident it was done to code and extra measures taken where asked. We also trust if anything were to happen in upcoming years Q7 would step up to fix the problem.
We highly and proudly recommend Q7 Roofing and Waterproofing Inc. based on both their workmanship and our experience with them.

user_reviews.Name: Alan Lee
user_reviews.Description:
For my issue, it was a kitchen sewer line that was leaking for past year underneath my crawlspace, and I was very pleased with the service that Chris and his team provided.

I cannot emphasize how professional and prompt Chris was to come to inspect the area. The crawlspace was a mess with sewage built up from the leaky sewer pipe with mold / flies / critters everywhere. We found out that the plumbing system was not assembled to code by previous ownership. Like other reviewers, he didn't even need to go down crawlspace and knew what was happening - which to me means he's definitely seen this many times, especially in aging homes in Bay Area! He immediately offered two options - one long term vs affordable option. Not wanting to sacrifice quality, I chose the long term option which was replacing the whole pipe / bringing the whole kitchen plumbing network to building code.

Chris and his team offered to fix the pipes and clean everything up at very reasonable prices with warranty as well. In half a day, everything was done and we saw immediate improvement in reduced sewer smell and flies.

Highly recommended. I'm looking forward to seeing whether to upgrade my future plumbing system like water pipes.

user_reviews.Name: dusty simon
user_reviews.Description:
I had a very disappointing experience with Roto-Rooter on a recent sewer job. I paid around $10,000 for work that is still not completed over a week later, and communication has been extremely poor throughout the process.

During the excavation, a trench over 7 feet deep was left open and workers entered the hole without any shoring or trench protection in place. This created serious safety concerns and appeared to violate basic OSHA safety requirements. I also have video evidence of the conditions on site.

In addition, there was an attempt to upsell me an additional “two-way cleanout” for about $6,000 after the original work was already underway and paid for. I have video evidence of that conversation as well, and it felt misleading based on how it was presented.

On top of that, the equipment used on my property caused damage to my sidewalk. The area where heavy machinery was placed is now holding water, which was not an issue before the work began and suggests either compaction or grading damage.

Overall, the job remains unfinished, communication has been lacking, and I am now dealing with both safety concerns and property damage. I am currently pursuing resolution through formal channels.
If you have Roger Leon show up expect to spend big money on false claims

user_reviews.Name: Scott Vestal
user_reviews.Description:
We are so glad we found this place! While towing our 5th wheel our engine gave up the ghost. We called Jim at Leal's. He arranged to have our truck towed to the shop, and our 5th wheel taken to an RV Resort, where we stayed during the repairs. He verified that the engine was beyond repair and quoted prices for a rebuilt one. We knew the transmission was on its last leg so we added that to the scope of work. While going over the truck he found our brakes were toast too.
In a terrible stroke of bad luck, the new engine came with a bad injector. He sourced all new injectors and replaced them over the weekend (even though they were closed). After some testing we got our truck back and finished our journey. Right after we unhooked our 5th wheel, the new transmission started acting up. Jim arranged to have it picked up the next day.
Bad parts can come from the factory, it happens. What the shop does about it is what's important.
Thank you to Jim and the rest of the crew for taking such good care of us.

user_reviews.Name: Kyle Carstens
user_reviews.Description:
Took my Dodge durango up here because I was having transmission problems. Now the guy Jim I spoke with was very friendly. Informed me of what was happening. Told me my only option was a new transmission. Or transmission rebuild.
I truly did not want to spend $7895.85 However, they warranty their product and their work one  year or twelve thousand miles.
Cool, so we struggle to find the money. We get the money and make the payment. We get our car back a little less than a month later. I go to pick up my car after final payment and here's my floor board! It did not look like this when it came to them. The carpet was not pulled back. The glove box was not ripped off and laying in the floorboard. You would think after paying almost eight thousand dollars, they would at least put everything back the way it goes properly. That's what makes me upset, and that's what leaves this review. I paid them almost as much as I paid for the entire vehicle, and they can't be bothered to put a glove box back in its proper position versus leaving it on my floor........ The owner finally reached back out to me and attempted to make things right. I can say that the owner has then very cordial on the phone. Each time that i've spoken with him and apologized for his employees and their lack of attention to detail when it comes to my vehicle. He also emailed me a warranty for their work. One year twelve thousand miles. Though he reached out my opinion still stands that I would not take another vehicle to this company and I would be very careful in the future of anybody who goes to this company. Get your quote in writing prior to taking your vehicle up there. Take pictures prior to you taking your vehicle up there. And once your vehicle is returned to, you go over every inch of the vehicle to make sure the job is done properly.

user_reviews.Description:
Giovani is simply the best! He knows his work and does not charge you an arm and a leg.
He is responsive, honest and punctual. I really appreciate how he explains the problem in layman terms so that I fully understand the issue.

This is a special shout out for the awesome work he did a few years ago, which is long over due.... I wanted to get a bidet installed and had a special request which was for it to be connected from the sink vanity so that I can have hot and cold functionality. Giovani listened to my idea and quoted me a reasonable price to do the work. I was very particular about being able to check if there might be a leak in the future since the connection was coming through a wall.. and also bidets are known to start leaking. Giovani came up with a brilliant idea of not sealing the cover plate which allowed me to check between the wall for any leaks.
It's been more than 4 years since he installed this and there are no leaks. Just goes to show he knows his craft well.

He also replaced toilets and fixed some leaks around the house. Giovani is my go to person for any plumbing projects/repairs.

user_reviews.Name: Elaine Chang
user_reviews.Description: I've never written a review before but Giovani did such a superb job that I had to!  My house of horrors from the 1960s has seen more than it's fair share of plumbers coming through but hands down, San Jose Drain and Main is the real deal.  My 13 year old son (who doesn't know his own strength) broke the shower handle.  Unfortunately, it wasn't as simple as replacing the shower handle as the shower cartridge was stuck and the valve needed to be replaced.  I contacted 7 plumbers before I reached out to Giovani and they all said the tile had to be broken in order to access the valve and replace it.  Giovani said he wasn't sure if he had to break the tile but he would try to avoid it. He ran through his proposed solution with me and it made sense so I had Giovani come back another day after he bought the parts.  He came on time as promised and took out the old cartridge and valve and welded the new valve into a very tight space (see picture) without having to break the tile!  He gave me a quote at the beginning of the job and even though it took way longer than anticipated (he was here from 2 pm to 7:30 pm), he still stuck to his original quote.  Now, that's what I call service and a job well done! Thank you Giovani and San Jose Drain and Main!!!

user_reviews.Name: Carol Yamane
user_reviews.Description:
In October, the hot water shower fixture got stuck I contacted Local Rooter and Plumbing for assistance. The valves in the hot and cold fixtures were replaced by Local Rooter and Plumbing in 2021 and the cold water fixture was tightened in 2024. Since this was the 3rd issue with the shower fixtures, Duy recommended converting the fixtures from 2 handle to single handle. During the conversion, Jaime found the plumbing was galvanized steel and recommended installing copper piping. A hole was cut in the wall behind the shower and the pipe was replaced. Wall patch, texturing, and painting was done once the job was completed.
I also asked Duy for advice regarding replacing the gas hot water heater. Since the heater was 21 years old, Duy suggested replacing the hot water heater with another gas water heater after a discussion about converting to an all electric one.
Duy is very responsive to emergency plumbing issues by scheduling an appointment within hours, all of my emergencies happened on a weekend. He explains the problem and repairs required well.  I also had him replace the original plumbing under the house in 2021. I highly recommend this company.

user_reviews.Name: Jon Small
user_reviews.Description:
We have an old home (by local standards), and our main waste line was buried under our slab foundation.  The line was cracked, with dips and accumulated rust and gunk to the point of failure.  Digging it up was unthinkable.  TrenchFree came highly recommended, with a solution for our situation.  They provide a cure-in-place pipe (CIPP) lining that essentially builds a new pipe inside the old janky one.

Working with them was one of the best experiences I've had with a contractor/service provider.  They came out to inspect, and showed us the issues with the line in real time with their inspection camera.  This was not inexpensive work, so we got a few additional opinions.  Comparing the bid experience, the referrals we got, and the confidence we felt in the proposal, we accepted the bid.

The crew that came out to do the work were professional, neat, quiet, respectful, and skilled.  They put in a full two days to complete the project, and kept us updated as they worked.  When they were done, they buttoned up and left our home as clean as they found it.

First, the CIPP solution was sort of magical.  Amazing how it works, and absolutely perfect for our situation (hopefully it lasts!)  Second, and equally importantly, I really could not have asked for anything more from the company.  They are a quality team who care about customer satisfaction. It's a no-brainer to give them a full 5 stars.

user_reviews.Description:
I used Street Plumbing as they were referred by warranty company to replace my water heater. They did replace the water heater under warranty but insisted to add an expansion tank to meet code and charged $750 for the addition of the small expansion tank. Looked it up online and the tank is only $50 and they charge $300 for the tank beside installation. I agreed as the overall cost was lower than trying to do it outside of warranty with the water heater on top.

A year later I find the pipe connection is all corroded and rusted (see pic). They used a galvanized pipe which is wrong type to use for water tank. Instead of using copper pipes so it doesn't rust. This is obviously a bad workmanship and no knowledge from the tech on the right type of pipe to use.
I called them to see if they would fix it given it's obviously a bad installation. They denied their fault and said we don't warrant materials?! What materials?! They chose the wrong material for the pipe and won't stand behind their mistakes.

Got another plumber and he replaced the connection and was surprised that someone used galvanized pipe on water heater. Don't recommend them for lack of basic knowledge and for over charging.

Update: first of all there was no city inspection as this was just a water heater replacement, so don’t make up stuff. The issue here is using wrong type of pipe (galvanized), which obviously you have hard time admitting to. I’m uploading a second picture after it was fixed by another plumber for $75 using the correct copper pipes. I don’t need to do it free, it’s a small fee, I just gave you the opportunity to fix your mistake.

user_reviews.Name: Krishnakumar Balasubramanian
user_reviews.Description: We did a major remodeling of our single family home and Prime Home Builders did a phenomenal job. We tried getting quotes from a bunch of other contractors all of whom came and took a look but never came back with a quote. We found out later that the reason was due to the fairly complex work required in our house.  Leo (owner) was very respectful from the beginning and showed interest in getting the business.   He patiently heard our goals with the remodeling, got his architect to come up with the plan and gave a reasonable quote. We stayed in the house while the remodeling was scheduled to happen.  We really liked the fact that Leo setup a temporary kitchen (including moving the dishwasher to one of our bedrooms) that was fully functional so that our toddler meals weren't affected.  Once the work commenced, we found out major issues with the wiring, plumbing (our house was built in 1959) and sewage line.  Leo offered to fix all of these and we pretty much rewired the house, repiped and laid a new sewer line for a reasonable price above the original quote. Leo even added wiring the house for cable and internet from a central closet location for free.  We really liked the pace with which Leo and his men finished the entire project which included a kitchen, a new master bathroom, a new guest bathroom, a new walk-in closet, upstairs bathroom and a media room, whole house (2 stories) electric rewiring, whole house repiping, a new sewer line (including fixing up the lawn)in 3 months flat. Leo pulled all the necessary permits from the city and the entire interaction was extremely professional. Overall, we highly recommend Leo and Prime Home Builders for your next home project.

user_reviews.Name: Victoria Hata
user_reviews.Description:
I’ve been bringing my cars to Akin’s Auto Repair for over a decade, since 2012—long before they moved to their current location. When my husband first told me about Akin’s, he said it was an auto shop you could actually trust. I was skeptical at first, but he was absolutely right!

Akin always takes the time to explain what’s wrong with my car, often showing me the parts that need replacement and walking me through the troubleshooting steps they used to find the issue. That level of transparency is rare and has built my total confidence in their work.

Over the years, I’ve also realized that I always leave Akin’s smiling. No one looks forward to car problems or waiting around in a repair shop—but somehow, I genuinely enjoy stopping by to say hi to everyone.

Akin and his team are consistently kind, professional, and helpful. My family and I sincerely appreciate all the repairs, maintenance, and oil changes they’ve done for us. If you’re looking for an honest mechanic who truly cares, I can’t recommend Akin’s Auto Repair enough.

user_reviews.Name: Alex Koretsky
user_reviews.Description:
I can't recommend SPS Plumbing enough as they saved me thousands and restored my faith in honest service! My tankless water heater (just 4 months out of warranty) started acting up, so I called three different plumbers. All of them even highly rated ones on Yelp and Google, inspected it and said I needed a full replacement. The quotes?  6,000 to 8,000. I was devastated, thinking I'd have to shell out a fortune.

I vented to a friend about it, and they immediately suggested Steve at SPS Plumbing. I called, and Steve and Vanessa were amazing from the get-go. They listened to my story, calmed me down, and assured me not to worry and they could fix it without replacing the whole unit. Their quote came in under $500 for parts and labor. What a relief!

They ordered the parts right away and scheduled the repair for just a day after everything arrived. Ruben showed up on time, was super friendly and professional, and knocked out the entire job quickly and cleanly. My water heater's been running perfectly ever since.

Honestly, I feel like those other plumbers were either trying to take advantage of the situation or just didn't know how to handle the repair. Don't fall for the big-ticket upsell just call SPS first. Steve, Vanessa, and Ruben are the real pros. Grateful beyond words!

user_reviews.Name: Joshua Bloch
user_reviews.Description:
Venture Plumbing did a large and complex repipe on our house, including a new sewer lateral, replacement of all waste pipes in the house, replacement of about 30% of our hot and cold water supply plumbing, replacement of several sinks and toilets, and installation of a Grundfos hot water recirculation system. The work required over a week with a five-person crew and was complicated by the presence of irreplaceable handmade tiles.

Their bid was not the cheapest, but neither was it the most expensive, and they definitely offered value for money. They were happy to accommodate special requests (e.g., installing unions for serviceability), and they are very much full-service plumbers. They contract with subcontractors to do tile and paint work, promising to leave your house in the condition they found it and to leave plumbing fully functional at the end of every working day. In our experience, they did exactly that.

Their communication was excellent before, during, and after the work. Their work exceeded our expectations, and their people exude competence, integrity, friendliness, and respect. They are a big enough organization to get things done quickly and efficiently, but small enough to operate with a human touch. Highly recommended!

user_reviews.Name: Barbara Weiss
user_reviews.Description:
I got 3 estimates for a trenchless replacement of my sewer pipe from the front yard to the street.   I was very impressed by Alex who came out to look over the project in order to make an accurate estimate. He made notes of my concerns about certain large plants which would need to be uprooted and assured me that they would be set aside and replanted.  It was also necessary to remove 3 stones from a custom walkway near the entry point of their equipment and, again, Alex made a note of the extra attention required and included it in his written estimate.  Alex explained the process, step by step from exposure of pipe, to hole digging, to permit and replacement. He gave me a best and worst case timeline (depending on when a city inspector would be available to sign off). The estimate was in my email box by the end of the day.
The crew arrived on schedule and all work was done promptly and completed on schedule. There was just one hour when I was unable to flush the toilet due to the work in progress.   Thomas was there to oversee the project and make sure things were done correctly and that care was taken to protect my landscaping and stone pathway.  I could not be more satisfied with the work done and how much attention was paid by Thomas to leaving my property in good and clean, tidy repair.  I recommend this company!

user_reviews.Name: Shankar Iyer
user_reviews.Description:
I called them for a simple clogged toilet. The tech was great, came and used a drain auger ($40 on Amazon) to fix it in 10 mins. Problem is that they charged me $400!!   That's price gouging.  While I admit they gave me an invoice before starting, they could have told me when I scheduled the appointment. Clearly they charge these rates for simple toilet clogs so why not be pricing transparent. Hard to wait for 3 hours for them and then send them back because I needed this fixed.

Per the response to the review, I called Pat Swanson who kindly replied to me that he was escalating and a corporate person would call. That person left a message simply stating that their standard prices for toilet repair started at $400 but they couldn't be transparent because it could be higher. Not a useful response at all. Simply put, this shows lack of price transparency and pricing that is outrageous and unfair.  Be forewarned when calling this company.

user_reviews.Name: Phil Ammirato
user_reviews.Description:
Terrible value/communication, but technical work seems good.

Feel taken advantage of, new homeowner with a leak in the wall behind the shower. They showed up to give a quote, pressured me to sign quickly.  I was stupid to panic and not get more quotes. Then when they come to do the work a few hours later they tell me for the first time they will have to replace the shower trim, give me no choice besides a chrome trim when I have bronze existing (obvious mismatch).

I later got other quotes after for less than half (wall was still open when they came so they could see everything). I look for 5 minutes on Home Depot’s website site and find a matching trim, install myself in another five minutes.

Positives: leak is fixed. The folks that did the technical work were friendly and did good work (I don’t blame them for the trim decision/communication). Wall repair was good.

Still feel we did not get a good value from the company, but learned an expensive lesson about dealing with stressful home repairs.
